rules: Only current/plausibly-current Wikidata P54 memberships survive the same temporal rule as the playable Brazilian roster.
Wikidata club discovery is restricted to entities classified as association football clubs (Q476028 or subclasses) in the target country.
A Wikidata club is accepted only when its English/Portuguese label or alt-label exactly matches one unique OpenFootball canonical club name or alias in the same country catalog.
A canonical OpenFootball club is rejected when more than one Wikidata QID matches it; no arbitrary identity winner is selected.
No fuzzy club-name matching is used. Ambiguous and unmatched labels are excluded.
Tier A resolves country club identities first, then retrieves memberships in bounded club batches to avoid oversized SPARQL joins.
Transient source failures or suspicious country-level drops preserve the previously published factual country slice and mark it stale-fallback instead of erasing known coverage.
Player identity is Wikidata QID first, then exact normalized name+date-of-birth during runtime merge.
Broad role groups remain factual groups; a tactical engine position derived from a broad group is explicitly estimated.
This artifact enriches background identities only and never creates a parallel domestic calendar.
